info.name: Tripadvisor Content Availability Location Photos API

params.name: locationId
params.description: The unique identifier for a Tripadvisor location (hotel, restaurant, or attraction).

params.name: language
params.description: The language code for the response content. Tripadvisor supports 29 languages.

items.docs: Returns up to 5 high-quality recent photos for a specific location. Photos are available in multiple sizes including thumbnail (50x50), small (150x150), medium (max 250px), large (max 550px), and original resolution.
